description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive mind map visualization using SVG. It includes functions for layout computation, node coloring, handling zooming and panning interactions, and rendering nodes and edges. The component supports features like zoom, drag to pan, and node selection.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined values gracefully.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates a radial-ish layout for nodes, positioning the center node at (0,0) and distributing other nodes on rings.

methods.name: getNodeColor
methods.description: Determines node fill color based on whether it's the center, selected, or dimmed.

methods.name: getNodeStroke
methods.description: Determines node stroke color based on whether it's the center, selected, or dimmed.
